sourceManifestLineEndingBridge: Canonical working legacy manifest is CRLF, canonical Git blob is LF; normalizing only CRLF reproduces exact declared source bytes. Ignored rebuild snapshot uses exact canonical Git blob; existing working legacy file unchanged.
limitations: No Pixelorama application launch, native export, playback or GUI save/reopen inspected.
Move/windup native timing linearizes source preview; actual runtime remains distance/progress driven; no runtime retiming or motion approval.
Six layers contain only visible source raster pixels; hidden overwritten geometry is unrecoverable and no new shadow is invented.
Existing static-v01 palette/compositor dependency of v2 author is preserved; no animation-v1 or animation-v3 inputs were used.
Manifest clock/location metadata is not byte-deterministic; all nine binary/source artifacts rebuild byte-identically.
